checks.name: better-sqlite3-v13-works-via-bundled-napi-prebuild
checks.evidence:
npm install better-sqlite3@^13.0.3: exit 0, no node-gyp invocation in the log (v13Text has "npm info ok": true).
Installed version: 13.0.3.
v13 switched from NAN/direct-V8 bindings to node-addon-api (N-API), which is ABI-stable across Node versions. The npm package ships prebuilt .node binaries directly under node_modules/better-sqlite3/prebuilds/ (darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-*, win32-arm64, win32-x64.node) rather than fetching a per-ABI tarball from GitHub releases — so install is instant and offline-safe once the tarball itself is fetched.
See experiments/s08-sqlite/npm-install-output-v13.txt for the full log.

checks.name: lease-race-exactly-one-winner-per-round
checks.evidence: 5 separate OS processes (own better-sqlite3 connection each, WAL + busy_timeout=5000ms) raced 200 rounds for scope_key='race:<n>' via BEGIN IMMEDIATE + INSERT...ON CONFLICT(scope_key) DO UPDATE...WHERE lease_until < now. Result: exactlyOneWinner=200/200, zeroWinners=0, multipleWinners=0. Winners spread across workers (real contention, not one worker lapping the rest): {"w0":31,"w1":35,"w2":44,"w3":47,"w4":43}. Sample: [{"round":0,"winner":"w4-r0"},{"round":1,"winner":"w0-r1"},{"round":2,"winner":"w2-r2"},{"round":3,"winner":"w2-r3"},{"round":4,"winner":"w1-r4"}]

checks.name: lease-expiry-allows-takeover

checks.name: lease-renewal-extends-and-blocks-steal

checks.name: git-checkpoint-then-commit-then-tag-then-restore
checks.evidence: Committed state.db after wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) as tag checkpoint/v1 (1 row), wrote a 2nd row + checkpointed + committed as checkpoint/v2 (2 rows). Checked out checkpoint/v1 (after closing the connection) and reopened: rows=[{"seq":1,"data":"batch1"}]. Checked back out to checkpoint/v2: rows=[{"seq":1,"data":"batch1"},{"seq":2,"data":"batch2-no-checkpoint"}]. Tags: checkpoint/v1, checkpoint/v2.

checks.name: git-commit-without-checkpoint-misses-wal-data
checks.evidence: After inserting a 2nd row with NO checkpoint, 'git status --porcelain' on state.db is empty (git sees no change — the row is only in state.db-wal, which is .gitignored): "". After wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE), the same command shows state.db as modified: " M state.db\n". Committing at the first point would have silently produced a checkpoint tag missing the 2nd row.
